mŏdimpĕrātor , ōris, m. for modi imperator,
I.the president or chairman of a convivial party, who prescribes the quantity to be drunk (the magister bibendi, the Greek συμποσίαρχος): potandi modimperatores, Varr. ap. Non. 142, 7.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
